description: Election Commission - Declare that S. Gowry and S. Loganathan as members of the Nuwaraeliya Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in a local government body (Nuwaraeliya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local authorities, including the declaration of selected members to fill vacancies that occurred due to party membership changes. This falls directly under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral processes and declarations related to local government elections.
